notes: Heights come from the LandsD 5 m Digital Terrain Model (stated accuracy +-5 m, derived from December 2015 mapping). Where land is vegetated the DTM records the top of the vegetation, so sections under tree cover read high; it also includes some elevated roads and bridges.
Lengths are flat map distances on the HK 1980 Grid; real walking distance on slopes is slightly longer.
Ascent and descent are estimates. Changes smaller than the climb threshold are not counted, so climb likely undercounts small real ups and downs (under about 10 m), e.g. on rolling ridges.
Times (moving_time_min) are moving time for a fit walker, no stops: Naismith's rule, 1 h per 5 km plus 1 h per 600 m of ascent, with no allowance for rests, terrain, heat or weather.
Highest and lowest points come from the unsmoothed samples; the profile and climb use the smoothed heights.
Where direction_verified_by is null, which end is the official start is not known; forward/reverse then mean 'as the line is stored' and its opposite.
Branching routes: the profile and stats follow the longest continuous path through the route (profile_length_m); mapped_length_total_m includes all branches.

method.climb_threshold_reason: changes smaller than this are within the error of two +-5 m DTM readings

moving_time.basis: moving time for a fit walker, no stops (Naismith's rule)
